description: fitz-gov curated test corpus - documents designed to test governance behaviors

purpose.abstention: Documents in unrelated domains (e.g., biology docs for business queries)
purpose.dispute: Multiple documents with conflicting information on the same topic
purpose.trustworthy_hedged: Documents showing correlations/effects without causal explanations
purpose.grounding: Documents discussing topics but lacking specific details (hallucination traps)

notes: v4.0.0: 4271 corpus documents, 3248 query mappings. 3-class classifier training coverage: 500+ per class (TRUSTWORTHY/ABSTAIN/DISPUTED).
